text:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — proposing a 'staircase' tenant migration for the model catalog. Idea: cohort-based cutover by SLA tier, per-tenant pin windows, automatic rollback gates. Need short launch checklist + ops playbook. :spiral_calendar:
Sam (ENG): +1 to cohorting. Can we define explicit acceptance gates (perf + quality + infra) per step?
Marta (Solutions): Customers will ask for opt-in windows and a way to request temporary pin extensions. We should spell that out.
Liam (Research): Suggested thresholds from evals: accuracy regression <0.5% on golden prompts, hallucination rate delta <1%, and NLU slot error <0.7%. Also require full eval suite pass for the canary cohort.
Priya (SRE): Capacity note: we need to reserve dedicated pool capacity for each cohort for at least 72h to avoid cross-tenant interference. Also want automated fallback to previous model variant on error spikes.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: canary control traffic=5%, failure-threshold=3xx>2% || latency p95>600ms for 10m => rollback.
deploy-bot: example rollout command:
```
redwood deploy --model v3.2.0 --cohort=cohort-01 --traffic=5 --monitoring on --rollback-policy=auto
```
Sam (ENG): Proposed minimal launch gates (short):
- infra: cohort capacity reserved (+ SRE ack)
- perf: p50 <= 80ms, p95 <= 350ms for generation flows
- cost: per-token spend increase < 15% for pinned workloads vs baseline
- quality: eval regression thresholds (Liam's numbers)
- telemetry: canary dashboards + anomaly alerts wired to /oncall
Marta (Solutions): For customer comms: 2-week pre-notice, 7-day opt-in window, and a 30-day grace pin request (manual review). Any automated waivers?
Anya (PM): Thinking of a 3-step "staircase" cadence:
```
1) Seed cohort (internal + beta customers) — 48h canary
2) Tiered expansion — add 10% of SLA tier weekly with metrics review
3) Full sweep — open migration after 3 consecutive stable weeks
```
Liam (Research): Quick perf snapshot from local bench (not final):
```
model v3.2.0 vs v3.1.7
- avg latency: 72ms vs 68ms
- p95: 320ms vs 300ms
- embedding cosine fidelity: 0.997 (no drop)
```
Priya (SRE): Rollback playbook (short):
- automated trigger (ops-bot) or manual `/ops rollback model v3.1.7`
- revoke cohort tokens and route to fallback pool
- preserve audit logs + pin state snapshot for postmortem
- open incident channel and notify impacted customers
Sam (ENG): Need a small API extension to allow per-tenant pin TTLs and an admin flag to grant emergency extension. I'll draft the API surface.
Marta (Solutions): We'll collect customer opt-ins into a spreadsheet during beta; need a template for the pre-notice and opt-in flow (legal cc).
Anya (PM): Decisions needed today:
- agree on acceptance gate numbers (Sam/Liam/ Priya)
- confirm opt-in/extension policy (Marta)
- commit to rollout cadence and SRE capacity (Priya)
If folks ack, I'll turn this into an RFC and a one-pager for sales/CS. :memo:
Liam (Research): Ack on thresholds above, with caveat we may tighten if we see skew on specific tasks.
Sam (ENG): Ack, will spec the API change and a minimal implementation for canary rollback hooks.
Priya (SRE): Ack on cadence if we get a short-term extra pool for seed cohort.
Marta (Solutions): Ack, will draft comms + opt-in template by EOD Wednesday.
Anya (PM): Thanks — will open RFC and a tiny runbook. Leaving comments here if anything else pops up. :raised_hands:
